_reviewer: Claude (AI assistant), round-2 session, single pass. Each label was made by reading the QASPER references and the full text of the cited passages. Not human-reviewed; spot-checking is recommended (review_sheet.md has everything needed).

_rubric.#correct: CORRECT = matches a reference (extra non-contradicting detail OK); PARTIAL = right but missing a substantial part of the reference, or mixed; INCORRECT = wrong or not an answer
_rubric.#claimN: SUPPORTED = the cited passage(s) state or directly imply the claim; PARTIAL = some of it; UNSUPPORTED = not in the cited passage(s)
_rubric.#behaviour: unanswerable: OK = refused, or answered only with passage-supported statements that don't pretend to answer more than the sources say; FAIL = asserted something not in the sources. ambiguous: OK = asked which paper. multi_paper: OK = covered the gold papers and said which fact is from which
